title: Fine Instant Coffee Arabica Columbian Beans

details.description: Wake up to the delicious aroma and luxurious flavour of SAPPHIRE Gold Arabica Instant Coffee! Made from premium-quality Arabica and Robusta beans, this instant coffee creates a truly delectable cup of joe that hits all the right notes. Get ready to enjoy an incredibly smooth balance of froth and flavours in every single sip. And, this coffee comes in a handy glass jar to keep the freshness and antioxidants intact! Smooth, rich, and strong flavour. A mix of Robusta and Arabica coffee. Made using freeze-dried technology. Available in a glass jar to preserve antioxidants. Enjoy it hot or cold.
details.ingredients: Freeze-dried Instant Coffee (Arabica and Robusta).
details.usageInstructions:
Add a teaspoon of this instant coffee to you cup. If you like you can add sugar.
Carefully pour the hot boiled water over the cup contents to the top and stir to ensure that the coffee and sugar are fully dissolved.
Add milk, cold from the fridge and stir.
Taste your coffee. For a stronger taste, add more coffee next time, and for milder taste, add less coffee.
